summary: Rapport Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for $150 million of 2.25% convertible senior notes due December 1, 2032, an ordinary capital-raising takedown rather than a special situation. Initial conversion price is approximately $26.7750 per share (37.3483 shares per $1,000), physical settlement fixed, with issuer redemption permitted on or after the later of December 6, 2030 and 60 days after topline FOCUS 1/FOCUS 2 and bipolar mania trial data, subject to a 130% stock-price hurdle. A separate concurrent equity offering prices 8,333,334 shares at $21.00. Watch conversion overhang, data-triggered redemption mechanics, and financing dilution.
